On the clean branch, complete-product coprimality implies each original old-slot condition in exactCell by divisibility. It is not put into exactCell or weight.

The actual Entry property gives total rank <= frozenSourceRankBound, so the existing absolute_noncoprime_payment applies. A tail-only bound is not substituted for this condition.
The existing cell proper-wall payment covers every root code and tail rank with the same mesh at each fixed Index.
A = sum of the original fixed nonnegative Entry marks and C = A+1 are fixed before N. Both errors get eta = epsilon/(2*C), leaving the coefficient-one main term unchanged.
